signatures.description: Given a set of error-prone short-read sequencing data with non-uniform coverage, build a compacted de Bruijn graph at a caller-chosen k, resolve heterozygous bubbles and tip branches under an explicit coverage/length policy, and emit contig paths plus a certificate showing every retained unitig covers each input k-mer exactly once. The assembler must be deterministic under any permutation of input edges and must report the minimal set of bubbles whose alternative paths cannot be decided from the data alone.
